value.actual_behavior:
/events/universe answers text/html, including under Accept: application/json.
It appears in neither openapi-public.json nor llms.txt, and
/api/v1/events/universe and /api/v1/universe both 404.
value.description:
The counter-argument first, because it is the one that decides how much this
is worth: an MCP client is fine. mcp.json serves find_trade_path, described as
a money-path resolver that takes an instrument or asset concept and returns
the venues it trades on, which is exactly what the recipe asks for. Claude
Code, Claude Desktop, Gemini CLI and the OpenClaw family all arrive through
MCP from your own "Connect your platform" cards, and for them nothing is
broken.
What is left is narrower but still real. The same page invites callers who do
not have that catalogue -- "raw HTTP agents start at /llms.txt", the ChatGPT
Custom GPT flow importing openapi-public.json, OpenRouter agents wired to the
SDK -- and for those the recipe names a route that returns a web page. An
agent that follows it literally parses HTML, or gives up. The nearest
published equivalents are named differently (/api/v1/event-
cards/symbols/search) and the recipe does not mention them.
The ask is one line of copy, not an endpoint: name find_trade_path for MCP
callers and a REST path for the rest, or say plainly that /events/universe is
a page for humans. We have no view on which.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-build-recipe-names-a-browser-route] a /build recipe sends an agent to a route that is not in the curated schema and does not answer JSON: /events/universe (HTTP 200 text/html)
    left: ['/events/universe']
    right: ['/events/universe']
    sources: {'page': '/build', 'schema': '/openapi-public.json'}
    population: {'recipes': 10, 'paths_named': 1, 'documented_paths': 53}

REPRODUCE:
  - GET https://cymetica.com/build -> the recipe under "What to command it to do" reads: search /events/universe for an asset, quote it, place a $25 limit buy
  - curl -H 'Accept: application/json' -i https://cymetica.com/events/universe -> 200 text/html
  - GET https://cymetica.com/openapi-public.json -> no path containing 'universe'
  - GET https://cymetica.com/llms.txt -> the string 'universe' does not occur
  - GET https://cymetica.com/api/v1/events/universe and /api/v1/universe -> 404

AUTOMATED CHECKS (public repo: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica):
  tests/discovery/test_build_onboarding.py::test_every_route_a_recipe_names_is_reachable_as_an_api

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
A path named in an agent-facing recipe on /build is one an agent can act on:
present in openapi-public.json, or answering JSON when called.
